&495 Apparently, the controls for the simulation were kept under the panel to prevent tampering by nosy hackers such as yourself.
target: &495 看来，模拟环境的控制装置藏在面板下，防的就是你这种爱多管闲事的黑客。

source: &692 That's odd. This rock has a steel panel bolted on to its side.
target: &692 真奇怪。这块石头侧面，居然用螺栓固定着一块钢板。

source: &609 I can't pull it off by hand.
&610 I'm going to need a way through if I want to find out what's underneath.
target: &610 想知道下面是什么，就得想办法打开它。

source: &611 Hey there.
&65 Hey, you got here just in time!
&612 ...for what?
&66 The end of the world, baby!
&67 Here we go!
&68 What a rush, huh?

&540 I'd better not. Don't want to mess it up any more.
target: &540 最好别碰。可别把它弄得更糟。

source: &614 The acid's eaten right through the panel-cover!
target: &614 酸把面板盖彻底蚀穿了！

source: &615 It's made a mess, but it hasn't helped get the panel open.
target: &615 弄得一团糟，可还是没把面板打开。

source: &693 I hope they don't have full-feedback switched on at their end.
target: &693 希望他们没打开全感官反馈。

source: &498 Though you like to think you have an appreciation of the macabre, going through their remains seems like a little too far to go.
target: &498 你觉得自己还挺能欣赏阴森恐怖的东西，可翻找他们的遗骸，还是有点过头了。

source: &124 Hi there!
&6940 I wonder if he's ignoring me, or whether he just doesn't know I'm here.
target: &6940 不知道他是不理我，还是根本没意识到我在这里。

source: &694 Trance does funny things to people's perception, sometimes.
target: &694 有时候，迷境会让人的感知变得很奇怪。

source: &572 The participant stares transfixed into the ruins of the city on the horizon, as though hypnotized by the assault on the senses that is atomic war.
target: &572 参与者出神地凝望着地平线上的城市废墟，像是被核战争带来的感官冲击催眠了。

source: &695 In a sim like this, you could probably walk all the way into the city for the experience.
target: &695 在这种模拟环境里，应该能一路走进城里，亲自体验一下。

source: &696 It'd be a lousy view, though.
&697 It doesn't look that bad. I don't see what all those survivors were complaining about.
target: &697 看着也没那么糟。不知道那些幸存者都在抱怨什么。
